summaryZh: 哈希表加双向链表的 O(1) LRU，按 key 过期，满了先清过期再淘汰，带命中率统计。
summaryEn: An O(1) LRU from a hash map and a linked list, per-key expiry, expired-first eviction and hit-rate stats.

milestones.zh: 手写哈希表加双向链表的 LRU，单元测试覆盖淘汰顺序
milestones.en: Hand-write the LRU from a hash map and a doubly linked list, with unit tests on eviction order

milestones.zh: 加 TTL：访问时检查过期，写满时先清过期
milestones.en: Add TTLs: check expiry on access, and drop expired entries first when full

milestones.zh: 包一层 HTTP 接口和 /stats，加锁后跑通验收脚本
milestones.en: Wrap it in the HTTP API and /stats, add locking, and pass the acceptance script

milestones.zh: 用一段访问日志测命中率，写进 README
milestones.en: Measure the hit rate on an access log and put it in the README

bulletZh: 用 {语言} 实现带 TTL 的 LRU 缓存服务（哈希表 + 双向链表，O(1) 读写），支持过期优先清理和命中率统计；在 {数据集} 上命中率 {X}%，单机 {QPS} QPS。
bulletEn: Built an LRU cache service with TTLs in {language} (hash map + doubly linked list, O(1) reads and writes) with expired-first cleanup and hit-rate stats; {X}% hit rate on {dataset}, {QPS} QPS on one node.

deepDive.zh: 为什么 LRU 要用双向链表？单链表行不行？
deepDive.en: Why does an LRU need a doubly linked list? Would a singly linked one do?

deepDive.zh: 过期时间是访问时检查还是后台扫描？各有什么问题？Redis 是怎么做的？
deepDive.en: Do you check expiry on access or sweep in the background? What goes wrong with each, and what does Redis do?

deepDive.zh: 整个缓存一把锁会成为瓶颈吗？怎么分段加锁，分段后 LRU 顺序还准吗？
deepDive.en: Is one lock for the whole cache a bottleneck? How would you shard the lock, and is the LRU order still exact afterwards?

deepDive.zh: 什么访问模式下 LRU 表现很差？LFU 或 W-TinyLFU 怎么改善？
deepDive.en: Which access patterns make LRU do badly, and how do LFU or W-TinyLFU help?

deepDive.zh: 缓存击穿、穿透、雪崩分别是什么？你的服务能挡住哪些？
deepDive.en: What are a cache stampede (a hot key expiring under load), cache penetration (lookups for keys that never exist) and a cache avalanche (many keys expiring at once), and which of them does your service protect against?

deepDive.zh: 多台缓存节点用取模分片有什么问题？一致性哈希怎么解决？
deepDive.en: What goes wrong when you shard cache nodes by modulo, and how does consistent hashing fix it?
